data: Which of the following methods consistently achieve an accuracy of over 70% in the cross-lingual classification task?

Wait a moment, let me verify this carefully. The question asks about methods achieving over 70% accuracy consistently. Looking at the graph, I need to check if any method maintains above 70% across all data points. 

The blue line (MT) shows some fluctuations but stays below 70%. The green line (Klementiev et al.) also fluctuates but stays below 70%. The red line (CorrNet) consistently stays above 70% across all data points. Therefore, CorrNet is the only method that meets the criteria.
